decisions.statement: A file is beside a page when the file has the page's whole name and a property's sections.
The folder is read rather than the index.
A path that is no TypeScript file has no page.
A folder that is not there is answered as holding no file rather than as a read that failed.
Which sections a property's file carries is answered by the naming grammar rather than here.
A property's file is beside its page whatever the property is called.
A name with sections that name no property of the page is left alone.
The files beside several paths have no repeated file.
The files beside several paths are sorted.
The files beside several paths have no path handed in.
A section list of two is read only where the key set handed in has that key.
A file no page claims cannot exist.
The naming grammar lets only this page claim a file with its name and a property's sections.

definition: the files beside a page, as they are on disk
